units.source_text: 七月初七乞巧，今年也和往年大不相同。

en.t: The Qixi Festival on the seventh day of the seventh month was very different from other years.

units.source_text: 六条院内并无管弦之会。

en.t: Within the Rokujo estate, there was no gathering for music.

units.source_text: 源氏镇日枯坐沉思，众侍女中也没有一人出去看双星相会。

en.t: Genji sat listlessly in thought all day, and not one of the waiting women went out to watch the two stars meet.

units.source_text: 天色未明，源氏独自起身，打开边门，

en.t: Before daybreak, Genji rose alone and opened the side door,

units.source_text: 从走廊的门中眺望庭院，但见朝露甚繁，

en.t: then gazed out at the garden from the corridor doorway and saw the morning dew lying thick everywhere,

units.source_text: 便走到廊上，赋诗述怀，诗曰：

en.t: so he stepped out onto the veranda and composed a poem to express his feelings, saying:
